subject: general
question: Which period has been described as the Golden Age of Indian history?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gupta period.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The period **between the 4th and 6th centuries CE** is called as the **Golden Age of India.**
 
• Because of the goodly achievements of Indians in the fields of **mathematics, astronomy, science, religion and philosophy during the Gupta Empire.**
 
• In Ancient India, the Gupta Dynasty governed the **mid-to-late 3rd century (approximately) to 543 AD**.
 
• **Established by Sri Gupta**, the dynasty rose to fame with rulers like **Chandragupta-I, Samudragupta,** etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3b51e088183e801634fc2237dde222344b6ab365a6feb5b52d8e3aa6e08ed04.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Mauryan Empire was **formed around 321 B.C.E. and ended in 185 B.C.E.**
 
• Magadha was ruled by the **Brihadratha dynasty, the Pradyota dynasty (682–544 BCE), the Haryana dynasty (544–413 BCE), and the Shaishunaga dynasty (413–345 BCE)**.
 
• The Mughal Empire was an **early-modern empire** that controlled much of South Asia between the **16th and 19th centuries. **** **
